ingredients.name: kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp Italian seasoning
salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat chicken dry with paper towels and medium dice.
When the onion is soft, increase heat to medium-high. Add chicken to the skillet and sauté until just cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
Add kale to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the kale to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 1-2 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (283 g) bag kale, cut and ready to use

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara to the skillet, stir to combine, and cook until warmed through, 1-2 minutes.
Add pasta to the skillet and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
